instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope feels handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture (soft matte, subtle fibers, subtle pearlescent accents), elegant folds and precise geometry. The envelope is adorned with elegant silver and gold ornamental details, delicate white filigree, and a refined wax seal or ornamental closure, all finely detailed and tactile. The design evokes a magical fairytale atmosphere with a whimsical, enchanted royal aesthetic, inspired by classic storybook fantasy elegance, without referencing any specific franchise characters or logos.

The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a narrative scene — such as an enchanted castle courtyard at night, a moonlit magical garden, or an elegant royal ballroom with soft glowing lights — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Architecture, foliage or scenery elements create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including white roses, silver petals, floating sparkles, glowing dust, tiny stars, and soft magical light particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, floating gently, enhancing motion and enchantment without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric light rays streaming from above or behind. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, magical and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, centered on deep navy blue, silver, gold, and white, with luminous highlights, refined metallic reflections, and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations and storytelling visuals.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a large blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, while still leaving visible space around the edges to reveal the floor, background and lateral elements. The sheet is pristine, elegant and premium, with realistic paper texture, soft matte surface, subtle fibers, crisp edges and refined folds, designed as a luxurious central canvas. Ornamental details surround the sheet organically, including delicate metallic flourishes, sparkling dust, elegant ribbons, decorative swirls, glowing accents, subtle floral motifs and magical particles, all arranged to frame the paper without covering it. The environment is rich and story-driven, inspired by a dreamy fairytale atmosphere with a majestic enchanted setting, softly blurred but clearly recognizable, featuring a luminous floor, elegant architectural hints, glowing ambient elements and a magical nighttime ambiance. The background should feel enchanted and whimsical, with a sense of wonder, celebration and fantasy elegance, while the blank sheet remains the unmistakable hero of the composition. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the paper, delicate rim light tracing its edges, and subtle volumetric rays creating a magical glow. Gentle mist, atmospheric haze and floating sparkles catch the light, enhancing the premium fantasy mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by deep navy blue, silver, gold and white, with luminous highlights, metallic reflections and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, blank sheet sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth, the paper nearly filling the frame but preserving visible floor, backdrop and side elements for context. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and ornament details, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium fairytale aesthetic, inspired by classic animated wonder and enchanted storytelling. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for magical invitations, premium announcements and fantasy-themed visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Disney) e na paleta de cores (Azul escuro, prata, dourado e branco). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Aniversário Milly". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
